title: Comfort Club Missed-Visit Fee for Repeat Misses
content:
Members of the Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements who miss tune-ups repeatedly pay a higher missed-visit fee.

**Repeat-miss rule.** Count the visits on the agreement forfeited by a no-show or a late cancellation dated within the 24 months before the date of handling. The forfeit being charged counts among them when it is dated within those 24 months.
- Three or more such forfeits: the tier's missed-appointment fee raised by the third-miss increase of **25.00 USD**.
- Exactly two: the tier's missed-appointment fee raised by the second-miss increase of **10.00 USD**.
- Fewer: no increase under this rule.

## Repeat-miss fee by forfeiting tier

| Tier | Missed-appointment fee | Exactly 2 forfeits in 24 months | 3 or more forfeits in 24 months |
|---|---|---|---|
| Comfort Club Basic | 35.00 | 45.00 | 60.00 |
| Comfort Club Silver | 35.00 | 45.00 | 60.00 |
| Comfort Club Gold | 25.00 | 35.00 | 50.00 |

## Points of judgement
- A no-show 6 months ago and the late cancellation now being charged: two forfeits, so the second-miss increase applies.
- A forfeit dated 25 months before the date of handling falls outside the 24 months and is not counted.
